courses.title: 4 Day Yoga and the Nervous System Teacher Training
courses.description: A 25-hour residential training at the Byron Bay centre for qualified yoga teachers on teaching with the nervous system in mind. It covers nervous system theory, Ayurvedic views of resilience, trauma-sensitive language and co-regulation, sequencing for deep rest, and peer teaching with feedback.

courses.title: 6 Day Remedial Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A 50-hour residential training, developed by the late Maria Kirsten and now led by Bec Isaacs, on adapting yoga to the individual. It draws on the Krishnamacharya and Viniyoga lineage, breath-centred āsana, the five koshas and the Yamas and Niyamas, with modifications for beginners, older students and those with injuries.

courses.title: Weekend Women's Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A three-day retreat for women held at the solstices and equinoxes, with daily yoga and meditation, seasonal ritual, yin yoga and a session on yoga for the moon and life cycles. Each one has its own seasonal theme, and the stay includes accommodation, vegetarian meals and a massage.
